description: Land Title Settlement Department  - Amendment  -  Halpe, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510026
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registrations and amendments under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains specific details about parcels of land, including cadastral map numbers, block numbers, village locations, and amendments to land title particulars such as rights of way, extent measurements, and ownership details. The content appears in "PART III - LANDS" of the gazette and involves land settlement matters handled by the Commissioner of Title Settlement, making it clearly fall under the Land Gazettes category.
